reference_materials: Exact Bürkle 5386-0041 manufacturer main, rounded-end and angular-end photographs inspected locally; not redistributed.
Texwipe TX609 product photograph and original TDS product table inspected locally; not redistributed.
findings: All eleven final inspector captures were visually inspected: four mast-spatula views, the independently assigned silicone-spatula top view, three bag views, the unwrapped stack and two individual-sheet views.

Two physical identities share one 150 mm spatula mesh. The round stem, angular blade and rounded blade follow manufacturer dimensions and photographs; blade thickness, forged transitions and edge radii are inferred.
The selected reference rests on the round stem with neutral roll. No artificial anti-roll support or dynamic stability credit was added.
The pack contains 300 separately named wipe sheets and two hollow packaging films. Stack and individual-sheet inspection modes reuse existing identities and add no stock.

The top and oblique pack views show readable original TX609, 300-wipe, size and composition text. Manufacturer artwork is not copied. The source pouch outline is approximated; wrinkles and film mechanics are unresolved.

Twelve wipes per fresh assembly are an inferred reservation. Thirty-six unique wipe identities are reserved for three fresh assemblies; 264 remain unreserved. No wiping or consumption has been executed.

Current geometry checks preserve negative inner cavity boundaries. Reproducing per-component normal repair fills the cavity and is rejected; a previously overlong inner pouch that crossed the outer seal is also retained as a rejection case.
geometry_limits: No manufacturer CAD or measured blade thickness, bag envelope, film thickness or wipe compression. These values remain explicit reconstruction hypotheses.
No flexible-sheet separation, bag opening, grease transfer, contamination control, dynamic settling or humanoid manipulation qualification.

The 3 L allocation in the existing waste can is an inferred planning reservation, not a measured wet-wipe capacity or material compatibility approval. Free liquids, sharps, coatings and clean packaging films are excluded.
The two clean packaging films retain identity, but their separate collection point remains unassigned. Full trial and reset consumption budgets are incomplete.
